item.title: [opencontainers/runc] runc v1.6.0 -- "All's well that ends well." (v1.6.0)
item.description:
This is the first stable release of the 1.6.z release branch of runc. It contains a handful of fixes and a few dependency bumps, including one fixing a medium security issue.
This release follows our release and support policy (see RELEASES.md for more details). This means that, as of this release:
* The runc 1.3.z (and earlier) release branches are now unsupported. * The runc 1.4.z release branch will now only receive high severity CVE fixes, and will no longer be supported in less than 6 months (end of April 2027). * The runc 1.5.z release branch will now only receive security and "significant" bugfixes. * Users are encouraged to plan migrating to runc 1.6.0 as soon as possible. * Despite this release being delayed by almost a month, users should still expect a runc 1.7.0 release in late April 2027.
### Security ###
This release includes github.com/moby/sys/user v0.5.1, which fixes the following medium-severity security issue:

item.title: [go-sql-driver/mysql] v1.11.0
item.description:
Changes since v1.10.2.
### Requirements
* The driver now requires Go 1.25 or later. The minimum supported server versions are MySQL 8.0 and MariaDB 10.11. (#1803)
### New features
* Add the `tinyInt1IsBool` DSN parameter and `TinyInt1IsBool` functional option, disabled by default to preserve numeric `TINYINT` behavior. When enabled, signed, non-`ZEROFILL` `TINYINT(1)` columns report `BOOLEAN` and scan types `bool` or `sql.NullBool`; zero is returned as `false` and non-zero values as `true`. This applies to both text-protocol queries and prepared statements. For non-NULL values, enabling the option makes integer scans fail and string scans return `"false"` or `"true"` instead of numeric strings. (#1805, #1845)

item.title: [yonaskolb/XcodeGen] 2.49.0
item.description:
### Added - Spec keys that XcodeGen doesn't recognise are now reported as warnings with their path, at every level of the spec, instead of being silently ignored. For example `Warning: Unknown key "resources" in targets.App will be ignored`, or a typo like `buildphase` in a source entry. Generation still succeeds. Keys starting with `x-` are not reported, so they can hold YAML anchors #1673 @yonaskolb
### Changed - `requiresObjCLinking` now defaults to `true` for static frameworks (`framework.static`, or `framework` with `MACH_O_TYPE: staticlib`), including targets from project references, so apps linking them get `-ObjC`. If this causes duplicate symbol errors or larger binaries, for example when several static frameworks share a package with Objective-C code like Firebase, set `requiresObjCLinking: false` on those frameworks #1674 @toyeshhm

item.title: [cli/cli] GitHub CLI 2.106.0 (v2.106.0)
item.description:
## Security
Seven security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in this release. Users are advised to update `gh` to version `v2.106.0` as soon as possible.
1. The terminal escape-sequence check used by `gh repo read-file`, `gh api`, and other commands did not recognize C1 control characters, allowing untrusted output to reach a terminal without neutralization.
See for more information.
2. Verbose and API-debug HTTP logging could print untrusted terminal control characters from request and response data.
See for more information.
3. `gh codespace ports` could print untrusted terminal control characters from port labels.
See for more information.
4. `gh agent-task view --log` could print untrusted terminal control characters from tool-call names and arguments.
See for more information.
5. `gh skill update` could install a skill from a different repository that reused the installed skill's name.

item.title: [semgrep/semgrep] Release v1.187.0 (v1.187.0)
item.description:
## 1.187.0 - 2026-11-24
### ### Changed
- Reduce scheduling overhead when scanning many small files by assigning files to worker domains in small batches. (chunk-target-dispatch) - Improved scan performance for taint rules. item.title: [nanaism/yomiyasu] v3.4.0
item.description:
yomiyasu v3.4.0 を公開しました。 スライドの見出しに読点を残さないようにし、推敲の前と後を比べる diff の誤った候補を減らして、話題ごとの入れ替わりを見直しの候補に足したバージョンです。
## 背景と課題
スライドの見出しに読点があると読む気がなくなる、という声がありました。3.3.0 までの lint が見出しで候補に出していたのは、間を作るだけの読点（文頭の「だから」や長い時の句、短い主題のすぐあとのもの）でした。3.3.0 で推敲したスライドにも見出しの読点が残ることがありました。
diff にも直すべき所がありました。3.3.0 で足した入れ子の主語の入れ替わりの候補は、「AすることとBすることを〜」の2つの節の順を入れ替えただけの推敲（意味は同じ）にも出ていました。また、AnIT さんの nihongo の v3.0.0 までのリリースと Issue 2・6 を読んで同じ形を試すと、4つの誤りと見落としが見つかりました。午後3時を15時と書き直しただけの推敲を数値の変化に数える、▲3% が 3% になった推敲を拾わない、一部を伏せた番号の「-」を負の符号に読む、話題ごとの担当の入れ替わりを拾わない、の4つです。
## v3.4.0 で変わったこと
- `--doc-type slides` の `#` で始まる見出し（文書の題を除く）の読点を、カギ括弧や引用符の中と数字の区切りのほかは全部 lint の候補に出し、推敲の手順でも見出しに読点を残さないようにしました。並べた語は「・」でつなぎ、条件や逆接は語を残して読点だけを外すか、語順を変えます。依頼で見出しの形が決まっているときは、その形を保ちます。 - diff は入れ子の主語の入れ替わりを探すときに、節を並べた文を見なくなりました。 - diff は午前・午後の時刻を24時制にそろえて比べ、▲と△を負の符号と読むようになりました。伏せた番号の「-」は符号と読まなくなりました。同じ時刻の午前と午後を入れ替えた推敲と、▲や△の符号が消えた推敲や付いた推敲は、意味が変わる恐れとして知らせます。 - 「初日の受付は田中さん、二日目は鈴木さん」のような文で担当を入れ替えた推敲と、否定が別の話題へ移った推敲を、見直しの候補として出します（`--fail-on` には数えません）。 -
... (truncated)

- BREAKING CHANGE: The `animateExit` mixin now starts animations synchronously in `beforeRemove` instead of deferring them to a microtask. This allows `animateLayout` to measure the updated layout when exiting elements are taken out of normal flow. (#12220)
